description: This class provides the default implementation for the reconnect configuration in the messaging service, including parameters like initial delay, interval, read journal batch size, and rate limiting, with methods to instantiate and access these settings.

classes.name: DefaultReconnectConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing reconnect behavior configuration with parameters like delay, interval, batch size, and rate control.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DefaultReconnectConfig instance from a given Config object.

methods.name: getInitialDelay
methods.description: Returns the initial delay Duration for reconnect attempts.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval Duration between reconnect attempts.

methods.name: getReadJournalBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the batch for journal reading during reconnect.

methods.name: getRateConfig
methods.description: Returns the rate configuration object controlling reconnect rate limits.
